issues.subject: Cursor — Software Engineer, Product / Growth / Agent Harness (multiple SF roles)
issues.details: Cursor's Ashby board lists 15+ San Francisco on-site full-time engineering roles with strong AI fit (Software Engineer - Product, Growth, Agent Harness, Bugbot, Generalist, etc.), but no compensation is disclosed on any posting.
